body: This is wrong, Godot string is UTF-32, so some string characters can map to two UTF-16 codepoints.
This is not sufficient to produce valid native path, use `fix_path` from `os_windows.cpp` instead.
Also wrong, `path_len` is UTF-32 length, and you are making copy of UTF-16 string, which can bigger length.

```suggestion
			p_text += "file://" + file.uri_encode() + "\r\n";
```
Since it's using `file://` URL, path should be escaped accordingly.

Is it `
` or should be just `
`? `
` is usually Windows specific line break.
Same, is it `\r\n` or `\n`?
Missing check for empty `p_files`.
Missing check for empty `p_files`.

Must be `\r\n`, the drag code is a reverse of the drop code so the lines here: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ec67cbe92628bdaf979b10594359ba6f02cf8838/platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_thread.cpp#L2788
Where the drop code cuts off `file://` and splits `\r\n`, the new drag code is generating it.

`file.uri_encode()` breaks file copy. I have not tested dnd on malformed file paths, but I know uri_encode breaks good paths.

`\r\n` it's the  text/uri-list mime type being handled on drop files here https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ec67cbe92628bdaf979b10594359ba6f02cf8838/platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_thread.cpp#L2788
.uri_encode() breaks file copying. Must not be applied here.
